newsitem.title: USA: Columbia Gas offering W Virginia pipes for sale.
newsitem.headline: Columbia Gas offering W Virginia pipes for sale.

text.p: Columbia Gas Transmission Corp, a unit of Columbia Gas System Inc, said Wednesday it was offering its natural gas gathering facilities in West Virginia for sale.

The company said it would open a data room October 14 to provide information on the three groups of assets, totaling about 1,200 miles of pipeline and related facilities, which collect gas from production wells and transport it to larger transmission lines.
Bids on the assets, including facilities in southwestern Pennsylvania and western Maryland, are due December 6.

For a company focused on interstate transportation and storage of natural gas, holding on to the gathering assets no longer made sense, said Shawn Casey, manager of Columbia Transmission's Charleston regional marketing group.
"Such ownership and operation is more appropriate for local gas producers or others who specialize in the gathering business," Casey said.
The company said it would only accept bids on groups of facilities, not individual lines.
